Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4011581. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and optionally to compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4011581. Return rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID.
